{"candidate_rtl":"module alu64_cla4(
    input  [63:0] x,
    input  [63:0] y,
    input         cin,
    output [63:0] s,
    output        cout
);
    wire [63:0] p;
    wire [63:0] g;
    wire [64:0] c;
    wire [16:0] bc;
    wire [15:0] bp;
    wire [15:0] bg;

    assign p = x ^ y;
    assign g = x & y;
    assign bc[0] = cin;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin : CLA_BLOCK
            assign bp[k] = p[4*k] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+3];
            assign bg[k] = g[4*k+3] |
                           (p[4*k+3] & g[4*k+2]) |
                           (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1]) |
                           (p[4*k+3] & p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]);
            assign bc[k+1] = bg[k] | (bp[k] & bc[k]);
            assign c[4*k] = bc[k];
            assign c[4*k+1] = g[4*k] | (p[4*k] & c[4*k]);
            assign c[4*k+2] = g[4*k+1] |
                              (p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]) |
                              (p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & c[4*k]);
            assign c[4*k+3] = g[4*k+2] |
                              (p[4*k+2] & g[4*k+1]) |
                              (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & g[4*k]) |
                              (p[4*k+2] & p[4*k+1] & p[4*k] & c[4*k]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign c[64] = bc[16];
    assign s = p ^ c[63:0];
    assign cout = c[64];
endmodule

module alu_64bit(
    input [63:0] a, b,
    input [2:0] Oper,
    output reg [63:0] sum
);
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_a;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_b;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_y;
    wire [63:0] arithmetic_sum;
    wire arithmetic_cout;

    assign arithmetic_a = (Oper == 3'b010) ? b : a;
    assign arithmetic_b = (Oper == 3'b010) ? a : b;
    assign arithmetic_y = arithmetic_b ^ {64{Oper[0]}};

    alu64_cla4 arithmetic_unit(
        .x(arithmetic_a),
        .y(arithmetic_y),
        .cin(Oper[0]),
        .s(arithmetic_sum),
        .cout(arithmetic_cout)
    );

    always @(*) begin
        case (Oper)
            3'b000: sum = arithmetic_sum;
            3'b001: sum = arithmetic_sum;
            3'b010: sum = arithmetic_sum;
            3'b011: sum = a | b;
            3'b100: sum = a & b;
            3'b101: sum = a ^ b;
            3'b110: sum = a ~^ b;
            default: sum = 64'b0;
        endcase
    end
endmodule","bottleneck":"The critical path is the carry dependency through the 64-bit add/subtract datapath, followed by operation selection into sum bits. The original mapped implementation exposes a long bit-serial carry and selection cone.","rewrite":"Use one shared add/subtract datapath with operand reversal and conditional inversion for operations 000, 001, and 010. Replace the serial carry chain with sixteen 4-bit carry-lookahead blocks, while retaining the original case priority and exact logic-operation mappings.","expected_timing_gain":"Expected reduction in maximum data arrival from approximately 3.05 ns, primarily by reducing the arithmetic carry depth from 64 bit stages to 16 block-carry stages plus local 4-bit lookahead. Actual gain depends on SKY130HD mapping of the generated wide-operand expressions.","area_or_other_cost":"The carry-lookahead equations add generate/propagate logic and may increase mapped area relative to the 11907.670400 um2 baseline. The shared arithmetic datapath avoids duplicating adders, and the expected area remains targeted below the 13098.437440 um2 cap, subject to synthesis mapping.","functional_boundaries":"The module name, ports, widths, signedness, and default behavior are preserved. For every 64-bit a and b and every 3-bit Oper value, sum matches the original: addition for 000, a-b for 001, b-a for 010, OR for 011, AND for 100, XOR for 101, XNOR for 110, and zero for 111. Internal carry output is not externally observable."}
